predecessor.title: Read+Update discovery limits carry no Transactional capability group

requirements.selectedText: Its `readUpdateAdvertisedLimits` definition is closed and uses the shared limit primitives. It admits exactly `page`, `request`, `resource`, `selector`, `patch`, `sequence`, `validation`, and `retention`; the `retention` object admits only `idempotency` and the pagination `maximumSnapshotLifetime`.

The Read discovery document's `limits` uses the closed `advertisedLimits` definition. Its Read-applicable groups are `page`, `request`, `resource`, `selector`, and `retention.maximumSnapshotLifetime`; the schema admits no `validation` group. Schema acceptance of a limit does not expose its capability.
A group is relevant only when the advertised profile exposes that capability.
the group is mutation surface: it is not advertised by a Read discovery document, and a Read+Update authority that omits diagnostics beyond a bound MUST advertise it
